id: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)

facts.text: Harold's order, once Kumar's done reading out thirty sliders
facts.why: Harold places the order himself: 'I want 30 sliders, 5 french fries, and 4 large Cherry Cokes.' Kumar only asks for the same with Diet Cokes.
facts.fix: Harold's order at the counter, thirty sliders and four large Cherry Cokes

facts.text: Harold's crispy fish sliders with tartare
facts.why: Harold's order in the film is thirty plain Slyders, five fries and four Cherry Cokes. No fish slider appears, so the dish loses Harold's name.

vibe.verdict: Right destination and the cheetah ride, but the night's best scenes and Harold's real order are left out.
missing: Burger Shack employee's rant about White Castle onions (New Brunswick)
Neil Patrick Harris paying for the order at the counter
Freakshow the tow truck mechanic (boils, his house)
The hang glider drop onto the castle
The raccoon bite on the roadside
Kumar's fake 911 call to bust Harold out
ideas: Swap 'Midnight cherry vanilla cola' for 'Large Cherry Coke' (Harold orders four large Cherry Cokes).
Swap 'Large sweet iced tea' for 'Kumar's large Diet Coke' (Kumar asks for the same as Harold, but Diet).
Swap the house 'Battered onion rings with ranch' for 'Burger Shack onion rings, not a patch on the castle' (the employee's rant).
Rename 'Jersey gravy fries' to 'Five orders of fries' (Harold's order, plus Kumar raising him five).
iconic: 30 Slyders, 5 fries and 4 large Cherry Cokes (cue, receipt, cola)
Riding the cheetah (dish name and wink)
Neil Patrick Harris as Doogie Howser stealing their car (malt shake)
Burger Shack and the White Castle onions (house starter, slider note)
The raccoon bite and Kumar's fake 911 call are left out
changed: Cue now Harold ordering thirty at the counter
Cola renamed for Harold's large order with a new note
Fries note now says Harold orders five
Slider note uses the itty-bitty onions line
House starter now Burger Shack onion rings
